newsitem.title: USA: Mutual Savings Bank Q4 net falls.
newsitem.headline: Mutual Savings Bank Q4 net falls.

text.p: Mutual Savings Bank (Michigan) said Tuesday its net income reached $284,000 in the fourth quarter ended December 31, versus $896,000 a year ago.

The company said the figure in 1995 included a $1.1 million gain on the sale of two branch offices and a $214,000 loss on the sale of investment and mortgage-backed securities. The 1996 figure includes a $156,000 special dividend on stock the company owns in a mortgage life reinsurance company and an $88,000 gain on the sale of real estate.
Mutual Savings Bank operates 22 offices in central and southern Michigan.
Its shares were trading off 1/8 Tuesday at 5-5/8.
